international.title: Botty? AI helps resurrect voice of John Motson for football video game
international.summary: Late broadcaster’s family allows EA Sports to create digital version of ‘Motty’ to commentate on popular FC27 First it was Val Kilmer, then Greta Garbo, but finally AI has resurrected a star the terraces can cheer for: John Motson, the BBC football pundit who died in February 2023, is coming back to commentate on the next generation of footballers – at least on a video game. The legendary commentator’s family has approved the use of AI technology to create a digital version of “Motty” – as he was ubiquitously known by generations of football fans – by EA Sports, which makes the popular football simulator FC27.
